scope: PM005 isolated loopback MVP only; legacy product and existing Pages are unchanged
baselineRiskStatus: UNCHANGED; new MVP guards do not verify or deploy the legacy Production product

riskMappings.SAI-R001: SQLite WAL/FULL transactions, real restart and backup restoration tests
riskMappings.SAI-R002: Authenticated membership and host/owner checks; reset disabled; explicit versioned cancellation review
riskMappings.SAI-R003: Opaque hashed sessions, exact Origin/Host, WebSocket membership and revocation checks
riskMappings.SAI-R004: Bounded messages, bodies, requests, auth concurrency, sockets; external APIs disabled
riskMappings.SAI-R007: Static client CSP, text-only DOM rendering, browser synthetic XSS checks

rules.requirement: Bind only 127.0.0.1. Refuse public bind and external API activation. No paid or public server provisioning.
Server UUID identity is authoritative; nickname is display text. Reject client-supplied sender/owner/RSVP identity fields.
Use salted scrypt password hashes, opaque session token digests, rotation, idle/absolute expiry, HttpOnly/SameSite cookies and logout revocation.
Require matching Host/Origin and CSRF on mutations. Revalidate sessions after request-body waits and memberships inside write transactions.
Authenticate WebSocket upgrade, enforce active room membership, cap connections/frames, revoke removed/expired/logout sessions and avoid stale-room reconnect.
Persist authoritative messages with a unique per-room/per-sender client message ID; confirm server storage and recipient delivery independently.
Persist proposals separately, create zero confirmed promises before explicit host CONFIRM; transactionally deduplicate confirmation.
Only each authenticated attendee may RSVP for themselves. Host confirmation never accepts for other participants.
Change/cancel requires a server-issued actor-bound expiring versioned review and explicit single-use approval. Preserve all history.
Keep plaintext synthetic credentials outside DB and Git in a separate private directory; auth hash/session tables are separate from domain data.
Run actual HTTP/WS normal/negative/bypass tests, independent browser identities, restart/crash and backup recovery checks. Physical devices and public staging are NOT_RUN until approved.
Preserve all existing risks and real incidents. Record first failures and fixes; require fresh independent verification before VERIFIED. Existing Pages artifact/workflow/source branch stay unchanged.
